notes.title: We will guide you through the known issues.
notes.content:
Hello, I'm the Harmagedon development team.

We will guide you to the bugs currently known in the game.
Known bugs are being fixed, and we will inform you of the patch note notice when it is resolved.

A known bug 

Boss 

 Among the boss attack patterns, there is a problem that the parring is not applied to the parringable pattern.


Character / System 

 There is a problem with player characters in the inventory looking too dark.
 There is a problem that animation is output unnaturally when multiple player actions are executed at the same time.
 There is a problem with the penalty that occurs when the player weight exceeds a certain percentage.


Others 

 There is a problem with the screen rapidly darkening in some terrain.
 There is a problem that when a person dies in a specific location, a recoverable breath object is created in an abnormal location.


Thank you.
